Petition of Fitchburg Gas and Electric Light Company d/b/a Unitil pursuant to § 8B.2.b of the Company’s Terms and Conditions for Competitive Suppliers (M.D.P.U. No. 285) for review and approval by the Department of Public Utilities of the Company's (1) Standard Complete Billing Percentages for effect December 1, 2017 and (2) reconciliation of competitive supplier balances for the period December 1, 2016 through November 31, 2017, under the Company’s Purchase of Receivables Program.
